text:
ashwin: Quick check — onboarding saffron13b. I pushed the weights to s3://redwood-models/saffron13b/v1/ but the tokenizer is occasionally returning <|unk|> for emojis and some punctuation sequences. Planning a bench run tomorrow; want to validate serving config + batch sizing before. Anyone seen this tokenizer quirk?

marco: I grabbed the weights earlier. path looks right. did you run the hf-tokenizer conversion script? sometimes the merges file needs normalizing.

ashwin: ran convert_tokenizer.sh from infra-scripts. no errors. tokenizer.json shows vocab_size 50256 which matches, but a few test cases hit unknowns.

lina: Emoji handling is often due to normalization/NFKC. we had to set `preserve_accents=false` in the conversion for ceres7b. try re-running with `--normalization NFKC`.

ashwin: ah good call. re-run queued. also fyi served config I'm planning: 
```
serve_config:
  model_path: s3://redwood-models/saffron13b/v1/
  kv_cache_size: 24GB
  batcher:
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
    max_batch_delay_ms: 12
    prefer_latency: true
  quant: fp16
```
Any obvious problems?

sophia: kv_cache_size looks tight depending on sequence length. if we expect 2k+ sequences during evals you might OOM. what's expected p95 seq length?

ashwin: for our benchmark suite p95 is 512 but we'll run a corner case with 2048. should I bump kv to 32GB?

kai: bump to 32GB for the corner run. Also set `max_batch_delay_ms` to 8 during bench to avoid queueing weirdness when we test micro latency.

rachel: re tokenizer — if you still see <|unk|> after NFKC, check the merges order and the bytes-to-unicode mapping. I can run a quick diff if you drop sample inputs.

ashwin: dropping samples here: 
```
"I love 🍣! -- party 🎉!!!"
"2026-03-17 — 10:00pm: scheduled maintenance?"
"C++17::std::optional? -> yes"
```

marco: benchbot FYI: scheduling nightly bench on saffron13b v1 at 03:00 UTC.

benchbot: Scheduled bench run 2478513000 for saffron13b/v1. Tests: latency_micro, throughput_batch, memory_leak_smoke. Notifying #eng-ml.

lina: also, small config nit: for the catalog entry make sure `model_variant` is set to "saffron13b-v1" explicitly so the routing policy finds it; otherwise fallback routing might pick saffron13b-quant.

ashwin: noted. adding that. question: for throughput sweeps, should I run with batch sizes 8/16/32 or base on tokens per batch?

kai: prefer tokens-per-batch sweep: 8k, 16k, 32k tokens. that maps to different request batch sizes depending on seq length. add a fixed-latency run with prefer_latency=true too.

ashwin: thanks. I'll: re-run tokenizer conversion with NFKC, bump kv_cache_size to 32GB for corner run, set max_batch_delay_ms=8 for micro-latency tests, add model_variant tag, and schedule token-based batch sweeps.

rachel: if you want I can CR the config in the morning and run the tokenizer diff. small chance merges order is the culprit.

ashwin: would love that. tagging @rachel for CR. I'll post bench results here once benchbot posts run summary. :thumbsup:

benchbot: Bench run 2478513000 completed. Summary: latency_micro p50=12ms p95=48ms, throughput_batch peak=2100 tokens/s, OOMs=0, tokenizer_unknown_rate=0.4%. Full logs: https://benchboard.internal/runs/2478513000

ashwin: nice. tokenizer_unknown_rate dropped from 2.1% to 0.4% after NFKC conversion. rachel, still want you to review merges?

rachel: yes will do a quick diff after lunch. if diff looks ok we can mark catalog readiness and flag for Dedicated smoke.

marco: great work. once CR done I'll help with Dedicated deploy checklist (GPU flavor + autoscale knobs).

ashwin: thanks team — closing loop after CR and final smoke deploy.
